blocks.en: After editing it again at home, I found that, just like the earlier mistake, there was an extra auth23.log after awk. Bringing in this file caused the awk command to scan auth.log again, so the output count was the total count in the file, not the count from the preceding pipe. So I changed it at home.
blocks.zh: 在回家后重新编辑的时候我发现awk后面和上面的错误一样多了auth23.log文件的拉取回导致awk命令会再次扫描auth.log 导致输出的数量是文件的总共数量而不是前面通过管道的数量所以在家我更改了一下
